name: Novice Fighter
Description: Every legend begins with a single swing.

name: Seasoned Warrior
Description: The battlefield is now your second home.

name: Battle-Hardened Veteran
Description: Scars tell stories only the worthy understand.

name: Berserker
Requirement: Defeat 20 enemies in a single rage state without dying
Description: Pain is fuel. Rage is the fire.

name: Slasher
Requirement: Deal 10,000 total damage with blade weapons
Description: Their blade dances leave only silence behind.

name: Executioner
Description: Justice is swift. Death is swifter.

Bonus Effect: +20% Damage to Dragon-Type Enemies, +10% Fire Resistance
Description: They say only the mad challenge dragons. The mad win.

name: Abyssal Reaper
Description: Death recognizes its own kind.

name: Godslayer
Requirement: Defeat a divine or god-tier enemy
Bonus Effect: +25% Damage to All Bosses, Immunity to Divine Seals

name: Warlord
Bonus Effect: +18% All Damage, +10% Armor, Party Morale Boost

name: Apocalypse Bringer
Requirement: Defeat 10 bosses in a single playthrough without taking fatal damage
Bonus Effect: +30% All Damage, +15% Critical Damage, AOE on Kill

name: Archer Supreme
Description: One shot. One kill. Every time.

name: Shield Bearer
Description: The wall that never falls.

name: Critical Strike Artist
Description: They strike where it hurts most.

name: Dual Wielder
Bonus Effect: +8% Attack Speed, +6% Damage with Dual Weapons
Description: Two blades, one purpose: destruction.

name: Spellblade
Requirement: Defeat 300 enemies using a combination of magic and melee
Bonus Effect: +10% Magic Damage, +10% Melee Damage, +5% Hybrid Damage
Description: Steel and sorcery united in purpose.

name: Unyielding
Requirement: Survive 50 encounters with less than 10% HP
Description: They break. They bend. They never fall.

name: Headshot Master
Description: Precision is not luck. It is art.

name: Massacre
Requirement: Defeat 50 enemies in a single battle
Description: When the dust settles, only silence remains.

name: Blood Knight
Description: They thrive in the chaos of near-death.

name: Parry Master
Description: The perfect defense is a devastating offense.

name: Siege Breaker

name: Necromancer's Bane

name: Final Stand
Requirement: Win a battle as the last party member alive 50 times
Bonus Effect: +25% All Stats When Solo, Last Stand Immunity (Once)
Description: Alone, but never defeated.

name: Beginner Explorer
Description: The first steps on an infinite road.

name: Trailblazer
Description: Where others fear to tread, they lead.

name: Cartographer

name: Pathfinder

name: World Walker

name: Lore Seeker

name: Skybound Scout

name: Deep Diver

name: Wilderness Survivor

Bonus Effect: +10% XP from Lore, +5% Ancient Artifact Find

name: Night Wanderer

name: Gatekeeper

name: Dimensional Traveler
Requirement: Visit 5 different planes, dimensions, or realms

name: Map Completer

name: Fog Walker
Requirement: Navigate through 15 areas with reduced visibility

name: Altar Finder
Description: They seek the sacred in forgotten places.

name: Relic Collector

name: Perpetual Wanderer

name: Journeyman Smith

name: Master Smith

name: Grand Alchemist

name: Expert Enchanter

name: Arcane Artificer

name: Transmutation Sage

name: Intimidator

name: Trusted Ally

name: Renowned Hero

name: Master Deceiver

name: Charismatic Leader

name: Betrayer

name: First Blood

name: Level Ascendant

name: Centurion

name: Paragon

name: Transcendent

name: Millionaire

name: Scourge of the Abyss
